summary: This task branch has no commits: HEAD is identical to fa3d6fd, the exact master tip that existed when the branch was created, and `git log master..HEAD` is empty. The apparent large diff against the current master ref is entirely attributable to unrelated repo history (other merged PRs) advancing past this stale fork point, not to any work performed by this task, so there is no actual reviewable diff. Because nothing was committed, there is nothing that can be merged, and the required worktree-branch-plus-PR audit trail was bypassed entirely.
